project: Example B — reference-driven redesign (repository-owned screenshot of preview/xiaomaomi-app.html rendered at 390x844 with Playwright; NOT a user-provided reference)

provenance.note: owner: repository (ui-ux-pro-max-skill, preview/xiaomaomi-app.html); licence: MIT (repository licence). rendered by the Principal agent during Example B; capture artefact: the fixed bottom nav appears mid-page because of full-page capture

observations.statement: Single-column portrait layout: app bar (logo+title left, two circular icon buttons right), hero profile card, '今日待办' 3-up quick-action cards, '今日动态' activity list, fixed 4-item bottom navigation.

Warm cream page background with white/cream cards; one dominant saturated orange used for the brand mark, numbers, avatar gradient, active nav item and status dots; deep brown-orange for headings and body text; peach for card borders.
observations.evidence: page background vs card fills; orange on title '小猫咪', stats '3/42', nav '首页'; borders of every card

observations.statement: Two secondary tints appear only on the quick-action icon tiles: light blue (玩耍) and mint green (健康); peach for the first tile.
observations.evidence: three square icon tiles in the 今日待办 row

observations.statement: Large corner radii everywhere: hero card and list cards ≈20–28px, quick-action cards ≈20px, icon tiles ≈12–14px, icon buttons and avatar fully circular, active nav item a rounded pill.
observations.evidence: corner curvature relative to the 390px frame

observations.statement: Every card has a thin (≈2px) peach outline in a lighter tint of the brand orange; no pure-black or grey outlines anywhere.
Surfaces read as flat with a very light lift; the only gradient is on the circular avatar (orange, lighter top-left). Shadows, if present, are too subtle to see at this capture scale.
observations.evidence: card edges show no visible dark halo

observations.statement: Rounded geometric sans-serif for display (title, section headers, stat numbers, bold), regular weight humanist sans for body/sub-labels; strong size contrast between stat numbers and their captions.
observations.evidence: '小猫咪', '喵小橘', '3 / 42 / 健康' vs captions

observations.statement: The exact font families cannot be read from the bitmap.
Icon buttons: white circle with peach outline, single-colour orange glyph; approximately 44px diameter at 390px width.
Bottom nav: 4 items, icon over label; active item = peach pill background + orange icon/text; inactive = muted brown icon/text.
List items: time label (muted) left, orange dot, bold title + muted subtitle; same card style as quick-action cards.
Icons are filled, single-colour glyphs with rounded corners; one style throughout (no outline/filled mixing).
observations.evidence: bell, gear, lock, paw, book, home, calendar, search, person

observations.statement: Brand mascot is a simplified silhouette-style cat glyph in a single brown-orange tone; no detailed character art.
Motion, hover and press states are not derivable from a static capture.
Muted captions (e.g. '橘猫 · 1岁2个月', '今日喂食') are mid-grey-brown on cream; contrast is plausible but must be measured in code, not from the bitmap.

rules.statement: One brand orange carries all emphasis (brand mark, key numbers, active state, status dots); secondary tints are reserved for category tiles only.
Radius ladder: cards 20–28px, tiles 12–14px, controls circular/pill; nothing below 12px except text.
All surfaces use a 2px peach outline (light tint of brand), never grey/black; outline is the primary separation device, shadow is secondary.
Two-family system: rounded display family for headings/numbers (bold), neutral sans for body; captions one step smaller and muted.
Filled rounded glyphs, single colour, same optical size across the app bar, tiles and nav.
Circular 44px white button with 2px peach outline and orange glyph.
Bottom nav active state = peach pill + orange icon/label; max 4–5 items.
Category tiles may use the secondary tints (blue/mint) — an intentional context exception to rule-1.

not_derivable: behaviour of the fixed nav on scroll
